description_en: Submits an AI podcast generation task
name: PodcastTaskSubmit

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Model Studio workspace for the current request
parameters.help_zh: 当前请求所使用的百炼业务空间id
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The URLs of source files (such as scripts) for the AI podcast generation task
parameters.help_zh: 用播客任务生成的文件可访问链接
parameters.name: file_urls

parameters.example: 甲流来袭，我们该如何应对？
parameters.help_en: The topic for generating the podcast content
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en: The voices to use for podcast generation. The first voice in the array corresponds to the first speaker
parameters.help_zh: 指定播客生成的人声音色，数组中的起始音色，为第一个对话人的音色
parameters.name: voices

parameters.example: 最近，甲型流感似乎成了大家热议的话题。但你真的了解甲流吗？它和普通感冒有什么区别？为什么症状看起来如此严重？更重要的是，我们应该如何预防和治疗？本期对话中，我们将深入探讨甲流的传播方式、易感人群以及科学的防护措施，帮助你在流感高发季节保护自己和家人的健康。
parameters.help_en: The source text for the AI podcast generation
parameters.name: text

parameters.help_en: The language for the generated podcast content, including both script and audio. The output will be in this language, regardless of the input language. Supported: "zh" (Chinese), "en" (English). Default: "zh"
parameters.help_zh: 播客内容生成的结果（包含播客稿、播客音频）语种选型，目前仅支持中文及英文，默认语种为中文
parameters.name: source_lang

taskStatus.description_en:
The task status.

PENDING: The task is created and awaiting execution.

RUNNING: The task is currently in progress.

SUCCEEDED: The task completed successfully.

INVALID: The request was invalid, often due to incorrect parameters or input.

FAILED: The task failed to complete due to an internal error.

UNKNOWN: The task status cannot be determined, which may indicate a temporary issue
taskStatus.description_zh:
任务状态。
PENDING：待执行
RUNNING：执行中
SUCCEEDED：成功
INVALID：失效
FAILED：失败
UNKNOWN： 未知

requestId.description_en: The request ID. Use this ID to trace the API call
requestId.description_zh: 请求id，用于追溯API调用链路

success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call was successful. `true` indicates success, and `false` indicates failure
success.description_zh: true 接口调用成功，false 接口调用失败
